A Sing2Notes alternative for solfa and choirs

Sing2Notes and NoteFusion both turn a sung recording into sheet music. NoteFusion also writes it in Tonic Solfa, and is built around choirs: parts, hymns and learning your line.

NoteFusion and Sing2Notes side by side

What this page says of Sing2Notes comes from Sing2Notes' Google Play and App Store listings, as of October 2026, and may have changed since. Sing2Notes is made by Klangio, which has nothing to do with NoteFusion.

What Sing2Notes does well

  • Turns a vocal recording into staff notation, from the microphone, a file or a YouTube link.
  • Exports PDF, MIDI and MusicXML for MuseScore, Sibelius and music software.
  • Has a desktop version in the browser and sister apps for piano, guitar and drums.

What NoteFusion adds

  • Tonic Solfa on every sheet, written the hymn-book way: movable doh from the key, la-based minor, chromatics named de, ra, fe, ta, and octave marks.
  • Choirs: alto, tenor and bass written under any tune, a recording of a choir read part by part, and Learn my part, with your line loud and the others soft.
  • Hymns: over 250 hymns with their words and 500 more hymn tunes in solfa and staff, and a hum to find one.
  • A fair free plan: 3 full transcriptions every week, a file read for its first three minutes, no card, no ads in the app; and one song bought on its own when that is all you need.
  • On Android and in any browser, with the same account and your sheets kept on the phone for offline.

Which to choose

Choose Sing2Notes if you write songs in a music program and want MIDI from your voice, with the rest of Klangio's apps beside it. Choose NoteFusion if your singers read Tonic Solfa, or you lead a choir or a worship team and want the parts, the hymns and a way for each singer to learn their line.

Or paste a song link

Links work for many songs, not all: YouTube sometimes blocks our downloads. If yours fails, upload the audio file instead.

Your first 30 seconds right here, with no account; an uploaded file is cut to its first 30 seconds. Create a free account for 3 full transcriptions every week, saved to your library.

Questions

Is NoteFusion free like Sing2Notes?

NoteFusion gives every free account 3 full transcriptions a week, of anything you sing, hum, play or upload, with no card. Songs from a link need Pro, or you can buy one song on its own.

Does Sing2Notes write Tonic Solfa?

Its own listing and website don't mention Tonic Solfa (checked in October 2026). NoteFusion writes every transcription in movable-doh Tonic Solfa beside the staff notation.

Can I open my sheets in MuseScore or Sibelius?

Yes. NoteFusion exports MusicXML and MIDI with Pro, and a PDF on every plan.
